description: Tag release fails after image verification because the SBOM action attempts a privileged release-asset upload
trigger: Any tag run ends with Resource not accessible by integration
mitigation: Disable implicit release-asset upload; retain SPDX through the pinned artifact step; protect with a regression test
contingency: Keep release blocked and rerun only after human review; do not grant contents write

description: Formal Gazebo evaluation evidence is absent
trigger: P1 gate review has fewer than 36 eligible external-runner logs or lacks independent false-completion audit
mitigation: Freeze launch/run commands and artifact layout; run the fixed scene/version matrix; index immutable raw logs
contingency: Stop P1 gate; reduce optional UI/LLM scope before reducing safety or verification scope

description: Hardware release has unresolved physical and commercial gates
trigger: hardware release report blocker_count is greater than zero
mitigation: Review each gate weekly; attach dated external evidence; preserve NOT_EXECUTED and BLOCKED states
contingency: Keep hardware release blocked and continue simulation-only work

description: Orders lack dated quotes AVL approval and incoming inspection evidence
mitigation: Collect comparable dated quotes; approve AVL; define and execute incoming inspection
contingency: Do not place production order; use approved evaluation samples only

description: External cold-start claim has fewer than three unique participant records
trigger: Any phase gate cites external reproducibility without three validated records
mitigation: Schedule three independent participants; preserve failures and environment metadata
contingency: Block the reproducibility claim and publish internal-only startup evidence

description: Repository code license and model-weight/asset approvals can diverge
trigger: A release includes a model weight or asset without a reviewed source license and redistribution decision
mitigation: Maintain separate third-party records; review every model and asset before inclusion
contingency: Exclude the unapproved model or asset; keep deterministic offline mode

description: Schema and Python model drift can break producers and consumers
trigger: An interfaces change is proposed without its matching model and three-owner review
mitigation: Require same-PR schema/model updates; run full contract validation; notify every consumer
contingency: Reject or revert the unapproved PR before merge

description: LLM work can consume capacity before the deterministic path is stable
trigger: Fixed scripted path fails ten consecutive runs or critical P1 integration slips more than one week
mitigation: Prioritize deterministic execution verification and replay; keep model runner optional
contingency: Remove the natural-language layer and preserve the deterministic evaluation

description: Continuous code and dependency security review is not a required gate
trigger: A dependency or sensitive boundary changes without automated security review
mitigation: Add least-privilege code/dependency scanning and a review standard; triage findings by severity
contingency: Block release for unresolved critical/high findings or document a time-bounded human exception

description: P3 start depends on Gazebo evidence and externally blocked hardware inputs
trigger: P1 formal evaluation or hardware input freeze misses its baseline date
mitigation: Track both dependency chains weekly; reallocate optional UI/LLM capacity to the critical path
contingency: Rebaseline P3 and communicate a simulation-only release scope
